title: Sony 50.3 mm f/1.45 full-frame imaging lens (US20190004278A1, example 5)

collection.attribution: Sony Corp, US20190004278A1 "Imaging lens and imaging apparatus". The prescription is the published numerical example 5; the native Project is a transcription of its surface table.
collection.redistribution: The numerical prescription is published in a patent application, a public record. The transcription, the native Project and this evidence extract are distributed under MIT. The patent document itself is not redistributed.

aperture_validity.basis: The publication states no clear or mechanical semi-diameter, so the transcription uses one uniform clear semi-diameter; the stop row is then the same size as its neighbours and does not bound the beam.
aperture_validity.satisfaction_basis: No pupil or field evidence is recorded, and the modelled stop does not bound the beam, so no stop-dependent match is claimed.
aperture_validity.consequence: The record supports first-order and structural queries only; a stop-dependent constraint stays unconfirmed.

spectrum.sampling_wavelengths_basis: The publication prints the d-line as its reference wavelength (587.56 nm in air). That value is converted once to the vacuum wavelength the engine evaluates, as the existing patent-derived records do.
spectrum.wavelength_precision: A single sample; no rounding in the Project.

sampling_span_nm.note: One sample, so the span is a 1 nm numerical window around it. It is not a second wavelength and not a measured band: sampling_wavelengths_nm holds exactly one value.

continuous_coverage_nm.note: The example states one reference wavelength only.

image_format.basis: Derived as 2 f tan(omega) from the printed focal length and half field angle: 42.76 mm, 1.2 % below the 43.27 mm diagonal of a 36 x 24 mm frame. The facet follows the family's 36 x 24 design and the derivation sits in the 2 % window used for that claim.

field.definition: Object-space half angle to the image height the example is corrected for.
field.image_height_basis: DERIVED from f tan(omega): the publication prints the angle, not the height.

effective_focal_length_mm.definition: Effective focal length as printed for the example

back_focal_length_mm.definition: Paraxial distance from the exit vertex to the rear focal point

total_track_mm.definition: Sum of the tabulated thicknesses from the first surface to the image plane in the committed Project.

engine_check.method: Thick-lens ABCD through the committed Project at the reference wavelength.

comparison.rule: |engine - source| <= atol + rtol * |source|. atol covers the printed 3-decimal focal length; rtol covers the printed radii and thicknesses, the constant-index material model and the engine's air-referenced index convention (about 0.13 % on EFL).

back_focal_length.basis: The publication prints no back focal length, so this quantity has no source value.

f_number.convention: Image-space F-number as printed for the example (Fno).

materials.basis: The publication prints one index and one Abbe number per element at the d-line, so every element is a constant index at the reference wavelength. No dispersion law is claimed and no catalogue glass is substituted; the vd values are kept in the evidence extract.

model_glasses.basis: SOURCE_STATED nd, used as a constant index

approximations.statement: Each element is a constant index equal to its printed nd, valid only at the reference wavelength; the printed vd values are kept in the evidence extract but are not modelled.
The publication states no semi-diameters; the Project uses one uniform 13.0 mm clear semi-diameter for every surface, which does not affect first-order properties.
The Project is the infinity-focus state; the printed gaps for the closer conjugates are kept in the evidence extract.

record_hash_method: SHA-256 over the record body with record_hash and record_hash_method removed, serialized as json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) in UTF-8 with no trailing newline.
